subject: Renewal — usage health & capacity plan
summary: Quarterly renewal check: PixelBay is seeing steady growth in token spend and requests an updated reserved capacity recommendation plus a short-term burst option to avoid overage. Internal plan includes a 12-month committed increase with flexible burst and an introductory discount tied to a 6-week onboarding milestone.
messages:
From: Amy Chen <amy.chen@pixelbay.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@pixelbay.com
Date: 2026-04-15T09:05:00Z
Subject: Renewal + capacity questions

Hi Ben,

Quick note ahead of our renewal in May — we've attached a month-to-date usage export (pixelbay_apr_usage_summary.csv). Overall usage is up ~35% month-over-month due to a new recommender feature we launched. We're worried about overage exposure and would like to discuss:

- A recommended reserved capacity tier for the next 12 months
- Temporary burst/bucket options for expected spikes (esp. week of May 3)
- Any ROI or performance notes to justify a larger commit to our execs

Can we get a short health/ROI recap and a pricing proposal this week? Procurement is copied.

Thanks,
Amy Chen
Director of Product
PixelBay

Attachment: pixelbay_apr_usage_summary.csv (CSV, 78 KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Amy Chen <amy.chen@pixelbay.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-04-15T11:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity questions

Hi Amy — thanks for the export and the heads up. High level: growth looks healthy and consistent with the recommender rollout. I looped in Laura (renewals) and Rishi (technical ops) to give a combined capacity + commercial plan.

Quick asks from our side so the proposal is tight:
- Can you confirm peak RPS and p50/p95 latency expectations you need to preserve?
- Is the May 3 spike expected to be sustained beyond that week?

Laura/Rishi — can you take the attached usage and sketch a 12-month reserved commit + a 10-day burst bucket option? Suggest we provide two pricing tiers (conservative and aggressive) and a performance ROI bullet (tokens/cost delta vs current).

Amy — I'll get a written plan and a pricing sheet back by tomorrow EOD.

Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0198

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Amy Chen <amy.chen@pixelbay.com>
Date: 2026-04-16T08:37:00Z
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity questions — proposal attached

Hi Amy — attached is a concise proposal (redwood_capacity_proposal_q2.pdf) and an updated pricing worksheet (emailed_pricing_sheet_v3.xlsx). TL;DR:

- Recommendation: move to Reserved Tier B (12-mo commit) at +40% token capacity vs current average with a 20% credit on overages for the first billing quarter.
- Burst option: 10-day burst bucket (pre-purchased) sized for estimated May 3 spike at the blended reserved + burst unit rate. Burst usage does not count toward the commit.
- Intro discount: 7% off list if contract signed within 14 days; additional professional services credits for an onboarding milestone (6-week adoption check).

ROI bullets (one-pager in the PDF):
- Estimated per-token cost reduction: 18% vs current pay-as-you-go profile at observed volumes.
- Expected monthly savings starting month 2 once recommender stabilizes: ~$3.4k on current run-rate.

Rishi: network/latency notes — we verified p95 < 180ms in us-west for similar recommender traffic at 1.5x current QPS during a 48-hour replay. I'm summarizing diagnostic traces in the PDF.

Next steps:
1) Amy/procurement: confirm acceptance of Tier B + burst bucket size.
2) If yes, Ben will issue a DocuSign with the pricing/rate table and the special terms.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 30-min call if you prefer to walk the execs through the ROI slide.

Laura Bennett
Renewals Manager | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai

Attachments: redwood_capacity_proposal_q2.pdf (6 pages), emailed_pricing_sheet_v3.xlsx (xlsx, 45 KB)

From: Amy Chen <amy.chen@pixelbay.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@pixelbay.com
Date: 2026-04-16T15:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity questions — proposal attached

Thanks Laura — this is exactly what we needed. Two quick notes from procurement & product:

1) Procurement asked if we can make the burst bucket refundable if unused (they prefer it as a commitment vs pre-purchase).
2) Product wants the 6-week milestone: can we make that a performance checkpoint tied to SLA credits (if p95 rises above 250ms during steady-state)?

We're inclined to accept Tier B + burst with the 7% sign-by discount pending these clarifications.

Also, can you confirm finalized per-token blended rate for the first 3 months? We'll need that in the DocuSign to expedite.

Amy Chen
Director of Product | PixelBay
amy.chen@pixelbay.com

- SLA checkpoint: we accept a 6-week performance milestone with SLA credit triggers (p95 threshold 250ms). If p95 > 250ms during steady-state windows, credit applies per the table in the DocuSign exhibit.
- Blended per-token rate (first 3 months): $0.00042/token (blended reserved + burst usage) — shown on pricing sheet.

Attached: finalized_pricing_and_terms_final.pdf (1 page) and the DocuSign link above.

Rishi/Tessa — please standby to run the onboarding replay on our test harness the week of Apr 26; we'll pair with PixelBay engineers for a quick smoke test once signed.

Ben Carter
